title: Paying for university education
prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone, while others think that students should pay for it themselves. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

title: Cars in city centres
prompt: Many cities are considering banning private cars from their centres. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this policy? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

title: Children and screen time
prompt: In many countries, children are spending more and more time looking at screens. What problems does this cause, and what can parents and schools do to deal with them? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

title: Living alone

title: Zoos and conservation

title: Why people change jobs so often

title: Government spending on the arts

title: Older and younger employees

title: Food waste

title: Advertising aimed at children

title: Ranking pupils at school
prompt: In some schools, pupils are regularly ranked against one another and the results are made public. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

title: Reducing reoffending
